Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Full Custom Layout: Execute full-custom IC and block-level layout from schematic to tape-out for ADC mixed-signal components

 * Excellent analytical skills to independently debug complex layout and physical verification issues

 * Excellent communication skills to bridge technical gaps across global, multidisciplinary engineering teams

 * The ability to guide, motivate, and coordinate small layout teams during project execution, and to collaborate closely with ADC Design Engineers

 * Fluent in English

This position is initially limited to a period of 2 years. We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualifications.
